title: "Interest Exchange"
next_chapter_hook: "At the very moment the two clasped hands and swore their oath, Chen Nian, sealed deep within the blood pool of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds thousands of miles away, suddenly opened her eyes—she sensed it, that call from the depths of her bloodline."

text.content:
"The seven-day deadline passed in an instant.

In the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the moonlight shone like frost. Chen Ji stood beneath an ancient pine, his robes gently swaying in the night wind, his face still wearing that harmless, timid expression. However, in the depths of his eyes, a gleam of light flashed and vanished.

A crescent moon hung in the sky, and a slender black shadow swept from the depths of the night, landing silently on the blue stone three zhang away. The visitor wore a light veil over her face, but a pair of autumn-water-like eyes could not hide the fierce aura surrounding her—it was the Demonic Path's Holy Maiden, Ye Qing."

dialogue.content: "Seven days have passed, yet the Holy Son remains quite composed."

"With the Holy Maiden personally visiting, how would Chen dare neglect my duties? It's just that sect affairs have been overwhelming these past days, preventing me from meeting as scheduled. I hope the Holy Maiden will forgive me."

text.content:
"Ye Qing's lips curved slightly, a faint smile playing at the corners. She stepped forward slowly, her figure beneath the black纱 ethereal and half-hidden, emanating a subtle, lingering fragrance.

"'Why is the Holy Son being so modest?' Her voice was cold and clear as a spring. 'From what I know, over these seven days, no one in the entire Tianqing Sect has seen the Holy Son appear. That oil lamp in the Servants' Quarters burned until dawn every night—what was Holy Son Chen doing?'

Chen Ji's heart stirred slightly, yet nothing showed on his face. He knew that this Demonic Path Holy Maiden before him was no ordinary person. The prophetic exchange seven days ago, though she had entered the game, had never truly let down her guard."

dialogue.content: ""Just some trivial matters. But since the Holy Maiden has come in the middle of the night, surely it's not just for old times' sake?"
""Straightforward."

text.content:
"Ye Qing swept her long sleeve, and three jade slips materialized凭空 between the two. The slips were entirely jet-black, yet faint crimson patterns swirled within them—clearly not ordinary objects.

"'Three jade slips. The first contains the complete route to the ancient secret realm, the 'Yinming Blood Sea,' including three little-known hidden entrance passages. The second is a defensive formation diagram of the Xuanwu Sect's internals, obtained by the Demonic Path after three years of painstaking intelligence gathering. The third—'

She paused, her gaze burning as she stared at Chen Ji.

"'The third is the Holy Sect's internal personnel layout. Who can be used, who can be trusted, who must be guarded against—everything detailed.'"

dialogue.content: ""Is this the 'increased leverage' the Holy Maiden mentioned?"
""What the Holy Sect wants has never been these superficial things. Since the Holy Son dares to ask for the secret realm routes, you must have sufficient chips to make me take this risk."

text.content:
"Ye Qing's words were as direct as a blade's edge, yet Chen Ji did not rush to respond. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, allowing the night wind to ruffle his robes, while his gaze remained fixed on the three jade slips.

Yinming Blood Sea. Xuanwu Sect's formation diagram. Holy Sect personnel.

Any one of these three items, if released, could spark a minor sect war. And Ye Qing had拿出 all three at once—she clearly saw that he had ulterior motives.

But what she didn't know was that what he plotted was far greater than she could imagine."

dialogue.content: ""The Holy Maiden's sincerity is evident. If Chen continues to hold back, it would be petty."

text.content:
"Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, and a stream of light flew from his sleeve. It was a yellowed page, its edges worn and broken, yet emanating an inexplicable ancient aura.

Tianji Record.

Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply.

"'Is this the source of the Holy Son's 'prophetic power'?' Her voice carried a rare tremor. 'That fragment... I once saw similar records in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. The Tianji Record, a supreme treasure from ancient times, capable of glimpsing Heavenly Secrets and reversing Heavenly Fate—'

"'The Holy Maiden is indeed knowledgeable.' Chen Ji returned the fragment to his sleeve, his tone calm. 'However, this fragment is too incomplete, its power less than a ten-thousandth of the complete volume. Each time it is used, it consumes five years of the user's lifespan. Therefore, unless absolutely necessary, Chen will not lightly employ it.'"

dialogue.content: ""...Five years of lifespan?"
""Calmly" The Holy Son is quite frank. Aren't you afraid I'll spread this secret?"

text.content:
"At these words, Chen Ji actually laughed softly.

"'If the Holy Maiden wished to leak this, why wait until today? Moreover—' He stepped forward, their eyes meeting. 'The Holy Maiden holds intelligence on the Yinming Blood Sea. If you weren't seeking something from Chen, why hand it over so readily? Though the Holy Sect is powerful, there must be reasons the Holy Maiden cannot act personally, correct?'

Ye Qing's gaze narrowed slightly.

She said nothing, but that moment of silence was the best answer.

Chen Ji knew he had won the gamble. The Demonic Path Holy Maiden's midnight visit was not simply for any 'cooperation.' Within the Holy Sect, she must have obstacles she desperately needed to remove."

dialogue.content: ""With profound meaning" The Holy Maiden can rest assured. Chen never acts at others' expense for personal gain. This time, each of us takes what we need."

text.content:
"After a long silence, Ye Qing suddenly lifted the light veil from her face.

Moonlight poured down, illuminating a cold and stunning visage. Yet Chen Ji noticed that in the depths of her eyes, there was an indelible gloom.

"'Since the Holy Son has been frank, I might as well say a few more words.' Her voice lowered. 'The commander of the Holy Sect is my uncle.'

Chen Ji's eyes flashed.

"'Three years ago, he personally sent me into the Holy Sect as a bargaining chip to consolidate his power. Holy Maiden in name, but merely a hostage in truth.' Ye Qing's tone was calm, calm to the point of coldness. 'I need a chance, a chance to make him fall beyond recovery. Since the Holy Son can glimpse Heavenly Secrets—I want to know, does he have weaknesses?'"

choice.prompt: "Ye Qing has revealed her blood relation to the Holy Sect commander—a crucial moment of trust. How do you choose to respond?"

choices.description: "Use the Tianji Record to show her a key prophetic vision, letting her witness the true prophetic power, establishing deep trust"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Ye Qing's absolute trust, unlock 'Demonic Path Underworld' support"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate is precious, and exposing your abilities may bring greater troubles"

dialogue.content: ""Closing his eyes in concentration" In that case, Chen will show the Holy Maiden something."

text.content:
"He drew out the Tianji Record fragment from his sleeve, his fingertip touching it lightly. Three breaths later, a blurry image actually appeared on the fragment—a middle-aged man in a black robe, kneeling before an altar, murmuring prayers to an upright eye.

"'This is—' Ye Qing rose abruptly, her expression dramatically changing. 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao? He actually... has connections with that thing?'"

dialogue.content: ""Voice trembling" So that's it... No wonder his actions have grown more erratic these years, sparing no cost. He was possessed by that thing!"

text.content:
"Chen Ji withdrew the fragment, his complexion slightly pale. This prophecy, though merely a fleeting glimpse, made him feel an unprecedented weakness. Heavenly Fate, another five points consumed.

"'This is the connection between the Holy Maiden's uncle and the Eye of Heavenly Dao.' His voice was hoarse, yet steady as a rock. 'In three days, he will personally come to the front lines to supervise. If someone acts against him from behind at that time, he will surely die.'"

dialogue.content: ""Drawing a deep breath, solemnly clasping fists" The Holy Son's great kindness, Qing'er will forever remember. From this day forward, the Holy Son's affairs are Qing'er's affairs. Through fire and water, I shall not refuse."

text.content:
"Ye Qing's attitude underwent a fundamental change. She no longer viewed Chen Ji merely as a usable piece, but as a true ally. That 'Qing'er' was the first time she referred to herself privately.

Chen Ji looked into her eyes and knew he had won the gamble. Though the consumption of Heavenly Fate hurt, what he gained in return was a powerful ally capable of stirring the Demonic Path."

choices.description: "Only reveal some secondary information, maintaining mystery while testing her sincerity"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain information advantage, do not expose trump cards"
choices.risk_hint: "May cause Ye Qing to feel you're not frank enough, limiting depth of cooperation"

dialogue.content: ""After沉吟" Though Chen can glimpse Heavenly Secrets, not everything is visible. However... the Holy Maiden's uncle's weakness, I do know somewhat."

text.content:
"He drew a jade slip from his sleeve and lightly tossed it to Ye Qing. 'This slip contains a name—the person he trusts most, and also a hidden operative planted by another faction within the Holy Sect. If the Holy Maiden starts from this person, unexpected gains may follow.'

Ye Qing received the slip, her divine sense probing within. Her expression gradually grew solemn. After a moment, she raised her head, her gaze carrying more complexity."

dialogue.content: ""With profound meaning" The Holy Son is indeed meticulous. This intelligence is so precise, surely you have been investigating in secret for some time?"
"'Chen merely keeps a sharper eye than most. Since the Holy Maiden's uncle is a hero of his caliber, Chen must know himself and know his enemy.'"

text.content:
"Ye Qing gazed at him for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh. 'Interesting.' She tucked the jade slip into her sleeve. 'I thought the Holy Son was just a lucky废物, but now it seems the '废物' needs quotation marks.'

"'The Holy Maiden flatters me.' Chen Ji cupped his hands in a bow. 'But Chen has one thing to say first—the price of this intelligence is the three jade slips the Holy Maiden mentioned just now, plus one promise.'

"'What promise?'

"'If Chen ever has need in the future, the Holy Maiden must provide Chen shelter once within the Demonic Path underworld. No excuses, regardless of what it concerns.'"

dialogue.content: ""Raising an eyebrow" The Holy Son has quite the appetite. But... I like it."

text.content:
"The two looked at each other and smiled, each with their own calculations. This game, on the surface calm and unruffled, actually churned with undercurrents. Chen Ji obtained the resources, intelligence support, and promises he wanted, while Ye Qing found a fulcrum sufficient to contend with her uncle.

As for who gained the upper hand in this exchange—that can only be determined in the days to come."

choices.description: "Do not give intelligence directly, instead propose more conditions, observing how much sincerity and bottom line she truly has"
choices.visible_reward: "Feel out Ye Qing's cards and bottom line"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing may sweep her sleeves and leave, ending cooperation"

dialogue.content: ""Shaking his head with a light laugh" The Holy Maiden misunderstands. Chen's intelligence has its worth, as the Holy Maiden knows. But these mere three jade slips are not enough."
""Narrowing his eyes" What does the Holy Son want?"

text.content:
"Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, saying leisurely: 'Chen asks for little. First, I want a contact method for the Holy Maiden's underworld network within the Holy Sect. Second, if I ever have conflict with the Tianqing Sect in the future, the Demonic Path must not take advantage. Third—'

He paused, his gaze meeting Ye Qing's directly.

"'Within three years, if Chen has need, the Holy Maiden must personally assist once.'

Ye Qing's expression grew dark. The first condition was acceptable, the second condition meant she had to forgo the chance to strike when vulnerable, and the third condition demanded she risk involvement in unknown disputes. Three conditions, each more excessive than the last."

dialogue.content: ""Cold smile" The Holy Son has quite the appetite. Aren't you afraid I'll sweep my sleeves and leave?"
""A slight smile" The Holy Maiden will not."

text.content:
"'Oh?' Ye Qing's tone cooled. 'What makes the Holy Son say that?'

Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, stopping only a zhang from her. 'Because the Holy Maiden has no more room to retreat. Three days ago, someone within the Holy Sect began to suspect the Holy Maiden's loyalty—if I guess correctly, the Holy Maiden's seclusion these seven days was to avoid something, wasn't it?'

Ye Qing's eyes narrowed sharply.

"'The Holy Maiden needs a strong ally, needs a force sufficient to make the Holy Sect wary.' Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet each word was like a nail. 'Looking across the world, the forces that can make the Holy Sect wary can be counted on one hand. My Tianqing Sect happens to be one of them.'

He cupped his hands, his tone calm. 'So the Holy Maiden will not leave. Because besides me, no one can give you what you want.'"

dialogue.content: ""After a long silence, suddenly breaking into a smile" Interesting... Holy Son Chen, I underestimated you."

text.content:
"Ye Qing's attitude suddenly shifted. That trace of anger dissolved, replaced by a kind of interest in sizing up prey.

"'Very well, I accept all three conditions.' She drew a jet-black令牌 from her sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji. 'This is the Demonic Path Holy Sect's Holy Maiden Seal. Whoever holds this seal can command my underworld network within the Holy Sect.'

Chen Ji caught the seal; it was cold to the touch. On the back of the seal was carved a mandala flower, lifelike and vivid.

"'But I have one condition as well.' Ye Qing's gaze burned. 'If the Holy Son truly manages to topple my uncle, I want to personally end him.'"

dialogue.content: ""Nodding" Deal."

text.content:
"Moonlight like water, the two stood between the pines and wind.

An exchange of interests concluded amid flashes of blades and pleasant smiles. Chen Ji obtained the resources, intelligence, and promises he wanted, while Ye Qing found a fulcrum sufficient to stir the winds and clouds of the Holy Sect.

As for how far this cooperation could go—that depends on future games of power.

But at least tonight, these two people who each took what they needed both wore satisfied smiles."
